toolboxes.name: A Vineyard for the Portfolio
toolboxes.description: A Simulation Game case for Pollis: a British drinks group negotiates to buy one of three wineries, in Chile, Italy and Australia, whose owners each know something it does not, then every winery is run for three years, on a Julia model the class can open afterwards.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Archaeology Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Archaeology Toolbox: archaeological prospection and the registers of ancient places, for archaeologists, heritage officers and museums. Makes terrain models from lidar point clouds, shows them as relief images, finds the places shaped like earthworks, and applies the trained models of ADAF to them; finds sites in satellite images with a model of known sites, and tests Enki, the network trained on tells of the Ancient Near East, on ground it was not trained on. Maps the ancient places of Pleiades and the Ancient Near East site placemarks of Pedersen.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Grow a Chocolate Chain
toolboxes.description: A Simulation Game case for Pollis: rival teams each run a chocolate brand in one country for five years, setting price, beans, shops, staff and marketing, on a Julia model the class can open afterwards.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Economics Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Economics Toolbox: business cycle filters, discrete-time stochastic volatility models, DSGE models, VAR/VECM systems, heterogeneous-agent models, continuous-time macro-finance and game theory.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Epidemiology Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Epidemiology Toolbox: inference of epidemiological parameters, inference on contact networks, compartmental models (SIR, SIS, SEIR, SIRS, SEIRD), branching processes, epidemics on networks and coinfection.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Finance Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Finance Toolbox: volatility measurement from daily and intraday prices, high-frequency covariance, ARIMAX models, GARCH-type, stochastic volatility and regime switching models, point processes, Bayesian asset-pricing factor models, portfolio optimisation, loss risk measures, extreme value analysis, and simulated limit order book markets.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Geoprocessing Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Geoprocessing Toolbox: calculations on rasters and elevation models in Julia. Computes local, focal and zonal operations on rasters, resamples them and puts polygons onto a grid with Rasters.jl and Stencils.jl, and computes the slope, aspect, hillshade, curvature, relief indices, upslope area and Topographic Wetness and Stream Power indices of an elevation model with Geomorphometry.jl and Stencils.jl, each replicated with R's terra, MultiscaleDTM or WhiteboxTools.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Historical Geography Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Historical Geography Toolbox: the past on the map, for historians, archaeologists, heritage officers, museums, and the municipalities and regions with history attached. Maps the borders of states with a year slider, from Cliopatria, the world maps of historical-basemaps and CShapes 2.0, and tells which states held a place over the centuries. Sets old maps beside today's map, with a line to swipe between them: the maps of Cassini and of the état-major and IGN's aerial photographs since 1950 for France, the maps that libraries have shared and Allmaps has georeferenced anywhere, and eight famous maps from the Tabula Peutingeriana to the Tasman map. Maps the populations of the past, from the European cities of Buringh, the world cities of Chandler and Modelski, and the grid of HYDE 3.5.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Self-Study: Learn and Practise
toolboxes.description: Turn your slides, notes and PDFs into what helps you study: more problems with their solutions, a topic explained in depth, a summary of a paper, prose and audio from slides, or slides from a long text. For students, and for teachers preparing their classes.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Core Mathematics Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Core Mathematics Toolbox: symbolic math, linear algebra, nonlinear systems, automatic and numerical differentiation, numerical integration, and ordinary and partial differential equations.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Merge or Be Bought
toolboxes.description: A Simulation Game case for Pollis: three listed bicycle makers, each run by a team as its board, bid for each other's shares for six quarters, on a Julia model the class can open afterwards.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Save the Company
toolboxes.description: A Simulation Game case for Pollis: the shareholders, banks and bondholders of a British retailer that cannot pay its debts negotiate a plan before its cash runs out, in four or six quarters, on a Julia model the class can open afterwards.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Smart Regions Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Smart Regions Toolbox: spatiotemporal infrastructure, pollution and climate, for municipalities and regional authorities in Smart Cities and Smart Rural Areas. Reads GeoJSON, GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoParquet, FlatGeobuf, KML and GPX files through DuckDB's spatial extension, reads GeoTIFF rasters, LAS and LAZ lidar point clouds, CityGML and CityJSON 3D city models, GTFS transit feeds and OpenStreetMap PBF extracts, reads the features of OpenStreetMap with a tag in an area from the Overpass API, and the layers or the full extract of a region from Geofabrik's download server, reads the places, buildings, roads, boundaries and addresses of an area from Overture Maps, reads the NUTS regions, local administrative units, countries and Urban Audit cities of Eurostat GISCO and maps Eurostat's tables on them, finds the INSPIRE datasets of administrative and statistical units in data.europa.eu and reads them from the countries' WFS, Atom feeds and OGC API Features, finds the Sentinel scenes of an area in the STAC catalogue of the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem and downloads the bands of a Sentinel-2 scene or of a Sentinel-1 monthly mosaic, finds the scenes of a dataset of USGS EarthExplorer through its Machine-to-Machine API and downloads the bands of a Landsat 8-9 scene or the SRTM elevation of an area, finds the lidar surveys and elevation models of an area in the catalogue of OpenTopography and downloads the elevation of an area from a global model or from the 3D Elevation Program of the U.S. Geological Survey, reads the street-level images of an area from the coverage tiles and image search of Mapillary, with their thumbnails and the map features located from them, opens the Mapillary image nearest a point, or one given by its id, in an interactive street-level viewer beside a map of Mapillary's coverage, builds the street network of an area from OpenStreetMap for walking, cycling or driving and finds the fastest routes, service areas, travel-time matrices and network measures of it with Graphs.jl, reads the commuting flows, trips, traffic counts and flights of cities from the open data of their statistical offices, transport authorities and the OpenSky Network, with the domestic air networks of the United States, Canada, India, Brazil and Australia, and fits gravity models to them with GLFixedEffectModels.jl, reads the aircraft over an area now, the arrivals and departures of an airport on a day and the track of an aircraft from the REST API of the OpenSky Network, and shows them on OpenStreetMap base maps.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Spatial Econometrics Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Spatial Econometrics Toolbox: regression models for data on regions, municipalities and other areas, where each area's outcome depends on its neighbours. Spatial lag and error models, geographically weighted regression, spatial discrete choice, spatial interaction models of flows, spatial panel data, spatio-temporal forecasting, spatial causal inference, shift-share designs, regionalisation with spatial regimes, spatial autocorrelation with Moran's I and Local Moran (LISA), kriging of a value measured at stations, and standard errors robust to spatial correlation.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Time-Series Forecasting Toolbox
toolboxes.description: Pollis Time-Series Forecasting Toolbox: BATS and TBATS, the Theta method and intermittent demand, neural network forecasting with LSTnet, DA-RNN, TPA-LSTM and DSANet, and automatic forecasting with auto ARIMA, auto ETS, auto ARARMA and a race between models.
toolboxes.author: Pollis

toolboxes.name: Trading Floor
toolboxes.description: A Simulation Game case for Pollis: trading desks buy and sell one company's shares on a live order book, period by period by the clock, as its results move the share's value and some desks receive hints first, on a Julia model the class can open afterwards.
toolboxes.author: Pollis
